==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=ImageSharp&min=ImageSharp&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Verify.ImageSharp: an Image is verified as an info file with its dimensions plus the image
        // itself, and bmp, gif, jpg, png and tif streams are re-encoded through ImageSharp.
        // The threshold has to be passed here: SSIM comparers are only registered when it is below
        // 1.0, and a per test SsimThreshold() does nothing until they are.
        VerifyImageSharp.Initialize(ssimThreshold: 1.0);

        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/ImageSharpTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=ImageSharp&min=ImageSharp&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using SixLabors.ImageSharp;
using SixLabors.ImageSharp.PixelFormats;

// Verify.ImageSharp: Verifies ImageSharp images as an info file plus the image, with optional SSIM based comparison.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.ImageSharp
// Note: Two files are produced per image: an info .txt and the image.
// Note: SSIM comparers are registered only when Initialize is given a threshold below 1.0; a per
// test SsimThreshold() does nothing until then.
// Note: The stream converters cover bmp, gif, jpg, png and tif, so a png another extension
// rendered is re-encoded by ImageSharp before it is written.
// Note: SsimComparer.Calculate(received, verified) returns the raw similarity, which is the number
// to choose a threshold from.
public class ImageSharpTests
{
    // Two files are written: an info .verified.txt with the width, height and resolution, and
    // the image itself. The info file makes a size change readable in a text diff.
    [Fact]
    public async Task VerifyImage()
    {
        using var image = new Image<Rgba32>(11, 11)
        {
            [5, 5] = Color.ParseHex("#0000FF").ToPixel<Rgba32>()
        };
        await Verify(image);
    }
}
